name: Fang of Githyiss

angles.text: As a young night elf adventurer in Shadowglen, you help defend Teldrassil by facing dangerous creatures and aiding Aldrassil’s researchers.
As an Alliance adventurer, you help researchers and young recruits learn about the dangerous wildlife near Aldrassil across Teldrassil.
As a druid, you watch Teldrassil’s natural balance by studying unusual predators and overgrown spiders in the surrounding wilds.

faq.answer: The fang is a fresh specimen from the great spider Githyiss. Its size gives researchers rare material to study arachnid predators near Aldrassil.
faq.q: What is the Fang of Githyiss?

faq.answer: Githyiss is a large, dangerous spider that prowls the forests near Aldrassil in Shadowglen. Its size threatens travelers and draws the interest of local naturalists.

aliases: who turns in fang of githyiss
where do i bring the fang
faq.answer: A scholar in Aldrassil who studies spiders wants the fang. Fresh specimens help researchers learn more about local arachnids.
faq.q: Who wants the Fang of Githyiss?

faq.answer: Aldrassil is Shadowglen’s great bough and central sanctuary, within the crown of the world tree Teldrassil. Young night elves train and find shelter there.

aliases: why do they study spiders in aldrassil
faq.answer: Aldrassil’s scholars and naturalists study local spiders to understand Shadowglen’s ecology and watch the aggressive, oversized beasts beneath Teldrassil’s canopy.
faq.q: Why are scholars in Aldrassil studying spider fangs?

aliases: can horde do fang of githyiss
faq.answer: No. Shadowglen, the night elf starting enclave atop Teldrassil, is open to Alliance adventurers beginning their journey in Aldrassil.
faq.q: Can Horde players turn in the Fang of Githyiss?

sections.body: Githyiss threatens travelers in Shadowglen’s wilds. The giant spider’s fang matters both as a danger and as a specimen worth studying. Scouts carry it through the underbrush to the sanctuary beneath the great tree.
sections.title: A Monstrous Specimen

sections.body: In Aldrassil, night elf naturalists and scholars watch the wildlife on the forest floor. A fresh, intact fang from a spider as large as Githyiss can teach them about arachnids beneath Teldrassil’s canopy. Researchers welcome the find as they study the glade’s aggressive creatures.
sections.title: Research in Aldrassil

summary: Near Aldrassil, Githyiss’s hunt brings a rare specimen to the sanctuary. Scholars can study the giant spider’s fang and watch for predators in Shadowglen.
